_readme: Hand-resolved (our player_id) -> MLB Stats API personId pairs, for scripts/detect_real_trades.py's name-search crosswalk (see context/features/phase-8-jersey-trade-detection-spec.md). Two reasons an entry belongs here: (1) MLB's /v1/people/search?names= returned zero matches (name spelled differently between ESPN and MLB, e.g. accents/suffixes) or (2) it returned more than one plausible match (a common name shared by multiple real MLB players) and automatic disambiguation by position/active-status still left it ambiguous. Each entry: { "player_id": <our players.json id>, "player_name": "...", "mlb_person_id": <statsapi personId>, "note": "why the automatic search needed help" }. Starts empty -- detect_real_trades.py logs any player it can't resolve automatically rather than guessing, and an entry only gets added here after a human confirms the right personId.
